'''Burloo''', known as '''"Bantha" Burloo,''' was a burly [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] who worked at [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]] in [[Bartyn's Landing]], a town on [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].<ref name="BL" />

==Biography==
Burloo was a tall, muscled [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living in the coastal town of [[Bartyn's Landing]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. He was nicknamed "[[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]]" Burloo. For as far as any neighbor could remember, Burloo had been seen in the company of [[Miss Mylla]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] who had arrived to Lamaredd at some point before [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]] along with several Falleen escorts.<ref name="BL" />

Miss Mylla eventually bought an inn and transformed it into [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]], an entertainment locale where customers could enjoy drinks served by scantily-clad waitresses or these women's company in private rooms. Burloo became the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] of the Saloon, standing always at a maximum of ten meters from the door, except when he was dealing with any problematic guest. The Saloon was always open, and Burloo appeared to be always on duty. Burloo was also partly responsible for the security of the courtesans &mdash; although most of them could take care of themselves.<ref name="BL" />

==Personality and traits==
At 225 centimeters of height and powerfully built, Burloo was an imposing presence in Lamaredd. He commonly carried with him a club, a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]] and a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] pistol &ndash; as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were uncommon in Lamaredd. He had several skills appropriate to his job, including the ability to intimidate, and was fluent in both [[Chagri/Legends|Chagri]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] &mdash; although he could only write Chagri.<ref name="BL" />

Burloo was a mysterious, silent person, rarely speaking unless absolutely necessary. Acting like a statue, he ignored everyone around him except patrons looking for trouble. Those people were prone to discover that Burloo's fist was as big as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] head.<ref name="BL" />
